title: A Dual-Dimensional LLM Framework for Automated Item Incidental Content Similarity Analysis in Large-Scale Assessments
abstract: arXiv:2608.24825v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid expansion of large-scale assessments and the growing adoption of automatic item generation have intensified concerns about incidental content redundancy, where construct-irrelevant elements such as wording or contextual framing become unintentionally repetitive across items. Traditional similarity metrics like BLEU or cosine similarity, often fail to capture the nuanced structural and semantic layers that drive perceived redundancy simultaneously. This study proposes a dual-dimensional framework for Automated Item Similarity Analysis (AISA) powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), operationalizing similarity through Structured Decomposition and Semantic Relatedness. Psychometric validation indicates that LLM-derived metrics align more closely with indicators of construct-irrelevant local dependence and yield more coherent item parameter groupings than traditional text-based measures. translated_title: 一种面向大规模评估中自动题目附带内容相似性分析的双维度大语言模型框架
translated_abstract: 大规模评估的迅速扩展以及自动题目生成的日益普及，加剧了人们对附带内容冗余的担忧，即诸如措辞或情境框架等与构念无关的元素在题目之间变得无意中重复。传统的相似性度量方法，如BLEU或余弦相似性，往往无法同时捕捉导致感知冗余的细微结构和语义层次。本研究提出了一种由大语言模型（LLMs）驱动的自动题目相似性分析（AISA）双维度框架，通过结构化分解和语义相关性来操作化相似性。心理测量学验证表明，与传统基于文本的度量相比，LLM衍生的度量与构念无关局部依赖的指标更为一致，并产生更连贯的题目参数分组。该框架进一步通过i进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的双维度自动题目相似性分析框架，通过结构化分解和语义相关性，更有效地捕捉大规模评估中附带内容的冗余，并在心理测量学验证中优于传统文本度量方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a dual-dimensional LLM-based framework for automated item similarity analysis, operationalizing similarity via structured decomposition and semantic relatedness, which outperforms traditional text-based metrics in psychometric validation for large-scale assessments.
